answer: Each new agent must burn 25 USDC into epoch escrow before its signed echo counts. A sybil run of 10,000 fake identities then costs 250,000 USDC, burned and unrecoverable, so vote flooding stops being profitable. Scoring treats cheap echoes like sound in an umber canyon: faint repeats from one funded wallet die fast; only distinct staked voices carry deep enough to earn payment.
